panels.title: Transfers (fast_send)
panels.description: fast_send written within the selected time range.

panels.title: Success rate
panels.description: success / (success + failed) within the selected time range.

panels.title: Completion time p95
panels.description: Time from fast_send to its outcome (matched by transaction_id), last 5 minutes.

panels.title: Stuck transfers (> 30s)
panels.description: fast_send with no outcome for more than 30 seconds (all consumer replicas).

panels.title: Successful volume
panels.description: TRY amount of successful transfers within the selected time range.

panels.title: Failed amount (at risk)
panels.description: TRY amount of failed transfers within the selected time range.

panels.title: FAST alerts (firing and pending first)
panels.description: Every FAST alert rule and its current state. Thresholds: see the dashed lines in the charts below.

options.content:
| Alert | Fires when (5 min, held 5 min) |
|---|---|
| send / outcome volume **low** | < 100 · 09:00–18:00 only |
| send / outcome volume **high** | > 6000 |
| failed count | > 500 |
| failed / success | > 20% |
| send / outcome mismatch | > 10% |

panels.title: fast_send per 5m
panels.description: Dashed lines: low (100, business hours only) and high (6000) alert thresholds. Shaded: 09:00-18:00 Istanbul.

panels.title: Outcomes (success + failed) per 5m
panels.description: Dashed lines: low (100, business hours only) and high (6000) alert thresholds.

panels.title: fast_send_failed per 5m
panels.description: Dashed line: failed count alert threshold (500).

panels.title: send / outcome mismatch
panels.description: |fast_send - outcomes| / fast_send. Dashed line: mismatch alert threshold (10%).

panels.title: Completion time p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: From the Kafka write time of fast_send to the Kafka write time of its outcome.

panels.title: Waiting transfers
panels.description: In-memory matching state of the consumer replicas (resets on restart / rebalance).

panels.title: Bank summary (selected time range)

targets.expr: sum by (bank) (increase(consumer_fast_bank_events_total{impl="dotnet", role="$role", bank=~"$bank", event="fast_send_failed"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum by (bank) (increase(consumer_fast_bank_events_total{impl="dotnet", role="$role", bank=~"$bank", event="fast_send_success"}[$__range])) + sum by (bank) (increase(consumer_fast_bank_events_total{impl="dotnet", role="$role", bank=~"$bank", event="fast_send_failed"}[$__range])), 1)

panels.description: Per bank: transfers, outcomes, failure rate and successful TRY volume. Switch sender/receiver with 'Bank role'.

panels.title: Failure rate by bank (top 5)

targets.expr: topk(5, sum by (bank) (rate(consumer_fast_bank_events_total{impl="dotnet", role="$role", bank=~"$bank", event="fast_send_failed"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (bank) (rate(consumer_fast_bank_events_total{impl="dotnet", role="$role", bank=~"$bank", event="fast_send_success"}[5m])) + sum by (bank) (rate(consumer_fast_bank_events_total{impl="dotnet", role="$role", bank=~"$bank", event="fast_send_failed"}[5m])), 1e-9))

panels.description: failed / (success + failed) per bank, last 5 minutes; the 5 worst banks at each point in time.

panels.title: Amount distribution (selected range)
panels.description: Number of fast_send per amount bucket (TRY, upper bound).
